text:
```yaml
name: Update eslint-plugin-sonarjs Changelog

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to generate changelog for'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  update-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update changelog
        env:
          JIRA_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.JIRA_API_TOKEN }}
          JIRA_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.JIRA_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          node tools/update-changelog.js "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update changelog for eslint-plugin-sonarjs ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          title: "chore: update changelog for eslint-plugin-sonarjs ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          body: "Automated changelog update for version ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          branch: "changelog-update-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          delete-branch: true
```
